scientific_integrity.limitations: The theorem assumes a nonconstant nonnegative-coefficient generating series analytic on a disk strictly larger than the critical disk. No claim is made for its limiting convergence radius or for incommensurable atomic supports. Historical priority remains subject to older Hausdorff semigroup literature whose complete primary text was not accessible.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Preadjoint eigenfunctions, Banach-dual spectral radius, holomorphic Calkin spectral mapping and polynomial factorization; exact finite diagnostics are supplemental
scientific_integrity.scope: Bounded positive geometric-lattice Hausdorff operators on analytic BMOA and Bloch spaces; Fredholm essential spectrum and point spectrum

title: Spectral saturation for geometric-lattice Hausdorff operators on BMOA and Bloch spaces
